calendar_era.name: The Age of Fractures
calendar_era.description: 847 years since the Sky Shattered. Three moons now hang where one once ruled. Magic leaks through the cracks in reality.

magic_system.name: Resonance Weaving
magic_system.description: Magic is the art of vibrating reality at specific frequencies. Weavers attune to one of five Resonances: Stone, Flame, Wind, Tide, or Void. Each Resonance grants unique abilities but exacts a physical toll. Void Weavers are hunted — their power comes from the cracks in the sky itself.
rules: Every spell costs body heat — overcasting causes frostburn
Void Resonance is forbidden in all Seven Kingdoms
Twin Resonances are possible but cause schizophrenic episodes
Resonance artifacts retain a fragment of their creator's soul

races.name: Humans
races.description: Dominant race of the Seven Kingdoms. Short-lived but adaptable. Produce the most Weavers.

races.name: Aetherkin
races.description: Tall, pale beings born with natural Void Resonance. Their skin shimmers with trapped starlight. Hunted by the Inquisition.

races.name: Stoneforged
races.description: Sentient constructs of living crystal and ore. Do not sleep, eat, or age. Created by the First Weavers as guardians.

races.name: Thornfolk
races.description: Small plant-humanoids from the Verdant Depths. Photosynthetic. Speak through rustling leaves and pheromones.

factions.name: The Weavers' Conclave
factions.description: Governing body of sanctioned magic. Train and license all non-Void Weavers. Answer to the Seven Crowns.

factions.name: The Void Ascendancy
factions.description: Secret society of Void Weavers. Believe the Sky Shattering was liberation, not catastrophe. Seek to widen the cracks.

factions.name: The Inquisition of Pure Light
factions.description: Religious order that hunts Void-touched beings and Void Weavers. Fanatical. Burn first, ask never.

factions.name: The Gearmonger Consortium
factions.description: Guild of artificers and Stoneforged. Build Resonance-powered machines. Control trade routes between kingdoms.

factions.name: The Thornwardens
factions.description: Thornfolk guardians of the Verdant Depths. Protect ancient forests from industrial expansion. Masters of biomancy.

characters.name: Kaelen Ashvale
characters.description: Young Weaver who accidentally attuned to Void Resonance. On the run from the Inquisition. Carries his mother's Resonance blade — it hums only for him.

characters.name: Elara Moonshard
characters.description: Last daughter of a purged Aetherkin noble house. Found refuge in the Verdant Depths. Knows secrets about why the Sky Shattered.

characters.name: Inquisitor-General Valdris Korr
characters.description: Head of the Inquisition. Implacable. His family was killed by a Void Weaver during the Cataclysm of Thornfall. His hatred is absolute — but so is his code of honor.

characters.name: Gearmaster Thunk-7
characters.description: 7th iteration of a Stoneforged artificer. Builds impossible machines. Speaks in binary and poetry. Remembers the world before the Shattering.

characters.name: Sylva Thornheart
characters.description: Thornwarden leader. Communicates through vines and flowers. Fierce protector of the forest. Has an unusual fondness for Kaelen.

locations.name: The Seven Kingdoms
locations.description: Fractured continent of human realms, united only by fear of the Void. Each kingdom has a Resonance specialty.

locations.name: Verdant Depths
locations.description: Ancient forest where Thornfolk dwell. Trees so tall their canopies form a second ground level. Thornwarden territory.

locations.name: The Sky-Cracks
locations.description: Visible rifts in the sky where Void energy seeps through. Northern lights made of raw magic. Airships avoid them.

locations.name: Ironhold Citadel
locations.description: Inquisition stronghold. Black iron spires. Prison for captured Void Weavers. Cells are lined with Nullstone — magic doesn't work inside.

locations.name: The Resonant Spire
locations.description: Conclave headquarters. A tower that amplifies Resonance — Weavers train here to master their craft. The top floor touches a Sky-Crack.

locations.name: Cogmarket
locations.description: Underground bazaar beneath the neutral city of Brassgate. Gearmonger territory. Anything can be bought here — including Void artifacts.

items.name: Mother's Resonance Blade
items.description: A sword that vibrates with trapped sound. When swung, it screams. Kaelen's inheritance. Attuned to his unique Twin Resonance.

items.name: Nullstone Shackles
items.description: Handcuffs carved from anti-magic stone. Used by the Inquisition to transport captured Weavers.

items.name: Sky-Shard
items.description: Fragment of the original moon. Pulses with Void energy. Highly illegal. Sought by the Void Ascendancy.

items.name: Gearmonger Pocket Engine
items.description: Thunk-7's masterpiece. A miniature perpetual motion machine powered by Resonance harmonics. Fits in a palm.

historical_events.name: The Sky Shattering
historical_events.description: The original moon exploded. No one knows why. The cracks released Void energy into the world, creating the first Weavers and the first Void-touched.

historical_events.name: The Cataclysm of Thornfall
historical_events.description: A Void Weaver destroyed the town of Thornfall, killing 3000 including Inquisitor-General Korr's family. This event sparked the Great Purge.

historical_events.name: The Great Purge
historical_events.description: Inquisition systematically hunted and executed Aetherkin across all Seven Kingdoms. 80% of Aetherkin population killed. Survivors went into hiding.

historical_events.name: The Verdant Concord
historical_events.description: Thornfolk and Stoneforged formed an alliance to protect the Verdant Depths from industrialization. First cross-species treaty in 400 years.

world_rules.name: Resonance Binding
world_rules.description: Every Weaver is born with or develops one Resonance. Dual Resonance is possible but dangerous — causes mental instability. Void Resonance is illegal.

world_rules.name: The Toll of Magic
world_rules.description: Casting drains body heat. Overcasting causes frostburn, hypothermia, and death. Master Weavers learn to regulate their temperature through breathing techniques.

world_rules.name: Nullstone
world_rules.description: Anti-magic mineral. Suppresses all Resonance within a radius. Mined exclusively by the Inquisition. Used in prisons, shackles, and execution chambers.

world_rules.name: Soul Fragments
world_rules.description: When a Weaver dies, part of their consciousness lingers in any artifact they created. These fragments can communicate with new owners.
